alt.en: A large violet database stands in the center of a gray floor. A dashed dark-gray arrow runs into it from a stack of pages at the front. A dotted gray line links it to a violet bar chart whose tallest bar is on the left. Behind, a teal glass agent cube is joined by a teal line to a teal tool tile.
alt.zh: 灰色地台中央是一座较大的紫色数据库。前方一叠纸张引出深灰色虚线箭头，指向数据库；数据库再以灰色点线连到右侧的紫色柱状图，最高的柱子在左边。后方的青绿色玻璃智能体方块以青绿色实线连接一块工具图块。

caption.en: Illustration: a stack of vulnerability records feeds a dataset whose cases are charted by severity, beside an AI agent linked to a tool, standing for the curated MCP vulnerability snapshot the authors describe. It does not depict a tested deployment, the authors' dataset or any real MCP system, and it does not show how many deployments are vulnerable.
caption.zh: 示意图：一叠漏洞记录汇入数据集，数据集中的案例按严重程度绘成柱状图，旁边是与工具相连的 AI 智能体，代表作者所述经整理的 MCP 漏洞快照。图中并非经过测试的部署，也不是作者的数据集或任何真实的 MCP 系统，更不表示有多少部署存在漏洞。
